title: Blow to the head from rockfall

presentation.chief_complaint: hit on the head by a rock
lay_descriptions: A rock came down and hit my climbing partner in the head. He was out for maybe a minute and now he's thrown up twice.
She got knocked on the head and keeps asking me the same question over and over.
My friend took a rock to the helmet. He says he's fine but he seems dazed and his headache is getting worse.
